I'll implement polling with a `useEffect` that depends on the operation's terminal-ness.

```tsx
const terminal = operation ? ["succeeded", "failed", "cancelled"].includes(operation.state) : true
useEffect(() => {
  if (!operation || terminal) return
  const id = operation.operationId
  let cancelled = false
  const timer = setTimeout(async () => {
    try {
      const next = await api.orchestrationOperation(id)
      if (!cancelled) setOperation(next)
    } catch (failure) {
      if (!cancelled) setError(problemOf(failure))
    }
  }, POLL_MILLIS)
  return () => { cancelled = true; clearTimeout(timer) }
}, [operation, terminal])
```
